title: Return the selected optimizer version to automation
description:
As an automation caller, I want a completed optimizer task to return the selected score version, so that guarded promotion can use the same persisted result contract as human-readable optimizer reporting.

Feature: Optimizer result identity

Scenario: Accepted candidate is returned to the caller
Given an optimization cycle accepts a candidate and records it as the last accepted version
When the procedure completes and persists its declared output
Then the task result includes winning_version_id for that accepted version
And the indexed optimizer summary and task result identify the same winning version
And no promotion occurs inside the optimizer itself

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. The optimizer procedure declares winning_version_id as a persisted output set from last_accepted_version_id, and the indexed summary (primus/cli/shared/optimizer_results.py) reports the same version. test_feedback_alignment_optimizer_config.py covers the output declaration and that the optimizer never promotes.
